caption: Read the trip dates and tags in a vertical timeline.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false);  return 'ok'; })()

caption: Edit the same Markwhen source file.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); v.showTab(true); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Read an mw block in a weekly review note.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen'].pro.signOut(); const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); await leaf.setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: { file: 'Pocket Markwhen/Weekly review.md', mode: 'preview' }, active: true }); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Collapse the Later group to read the trip events.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); v.containerEl.querySelector('.pocket-markwhen-group').open = false; return 'ok'; })()

caption: Keep dates that overlap the selected range.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); v.panel.applyFilter({from:'2026-03-02',to:'2026-03-05',tag:''}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Today highlights the next event and opens its group.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.signOut(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); v.panel.goToday('2026-10-12'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro combines travel and work events in one view.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pocket-markwhen-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); await v.panel.combine(['Pocket Markwhen/Work.mw']); v.panel.applyFilter({from:'2026-03-02',to:'2026-03-09',tag:''}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro saves the Italy tag and date filter.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pocket-markwhen-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); v.panel.applyFilter({from:'2026-03-02',to:'2026-03-08',tag:'italy'}); await v.panel.saveFilter('Italy trip'); const saved = v.containerEl.querySelector('select[aria-label="Saved filter"]'); saved.value = 'Italy trip'; saved.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); v.containerEl.querySelector('.pocket-markwhen-pro details').open = true; return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro writes the filtered events as a Markdown list.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('pocket-markwhen-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.openTimeline(app.vault.getFileByPath('Pocket Markwhen/Trip.mw')); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.showTab(false); v.panel.applyFilter({from:'2026-03-02',to:'2026-03-08',tag:'italy'}); const path = await v.panel.exportMarkdown(); window.__pmExport = path; await app.workspace.getLeaf(true).openFile(app.vault.getFileByPath(path)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(window.__pmExport); app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().detach(); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); app.plugins.plugins['pocket-markwhen'].pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()
